title: A molecular dynamics approach to mapping DNA-binding modes of a nuclear receptor family in a non-model organism: An in silico analysis of the Magallana gigas genome.
authors: Brascher, Theo C; Melo, Manuel N; Bainy, Afonso C D; Razzera, Guilherme
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接与Martini 3粗粒化MD模拟，系统解析非模式生物太平洋牡蛎核受体家族DBD的DNA结合模式与响应元件，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，方法先进且高度匹配本课题。
abstract: Nuclear receptors (NRs) are protein transcription factors that regulate key genes across diverse physiological processes. The DNA-binding domain (DBD) binds specific DNA sequences (response elements, REs) in target gene promoters. Previous studies identified 43 putative NRs in the Magallana gigas genome. However, limited information is available regarding the functionality of these NRs. DBD analysis can provide insight into binding modes and potential target REs. This study aimed to investigate the structure and functionality of the DBDs of NRs in M. gigas. Initially, 3D modeling of M. gigas DBDs revealed three primary structural conformations. DNA interaction structures for all M. gigas DBDs were obtained through molecular docking. To validate the DNA-protein poses, a Martini 3 DNA model was built and 30 mus triplicate production MD simulations were performed for each DBD-DNA system, totaling  approximately 4000 mus of simulation time. In total, 20 M. gigas NRs were identified as promising candidates, exhibiting structural similarity to known NRs. Likely DNA-binding poses and REs were proposed for these receptors, including homologs such as RXR, RAR, PPAR, THR, FTZF1, NGF1, HNF4, and members of the newly described P family. 13 NRs were classified as intermediate, suggesting minor modifications could optimize DNA binding, while 10 were structurally divergent or novel in their DNA-binding features. This study provides valuable insights into the functional mechanisms of M. gigas NRs. Furthermore, it introduces a simplified Martini 3 DNA model tailored for DNA-protein interaction studies.
abstract_zh: 核受体（nuclear receptors, NRs）是调节多种生理过程中关键基因的蛋白质转录因子。DNA结合域（DNA-binding domain, DBD）与靶基因启动子中的特定DNA序列（反应元件，response elements, REs）结合。先前研究在Magallana gigas基因组中鉴定出43个推定NRs。然而，关于这些NRs功能的信息有限。DBD分析可提供对结合模式和潜在靶REs的深入见解。本研究旨在探究M. gigas中NRs的DBD结构与功能。首先，M. gigas DBDs的三维建模揭示了三种主要结构构象。通过分子对接（molecular docking）获得了所有M. gigas DBDs的DNA相互作用结构。为验证DNA-蛋白质姿态，构建了Martini 3 DNA模型，并对每个DBD-DNA系统进行了30 μs的三次重复生产性分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，总计约4000 μs的模拟时间。共鉴定出20个M. gigas NRs为有前景的候选者，其结构与已知NRs相似。为这些受体提出了可能的DNA结合姿态和REs，包括同源物如RXR、RAR、PPAR、THR、FTZF1、NGF1、HNF4，以及新描述的P家族成员。13个NRs被归类为中间型，表明微小修饰可能优化DNA结合，而10个在DNA结合特征上结构分化或新颖。本研究为M. gigas NRs的功能机制提供了宝贵见解。此外，引入了一种专为DNA-蛋白质相互作用研究设计的简化Martini 3 DNA模型。
